name: Rule-Based Irrigation Baseline
description: A transparent, agriculturally grounded baseline for irrigation prediction. Based on the widely accepted agronomic principle that irrigation is triggered when available soil moisture falls below the field capacity threshold.
rule: IF SoilMoisture < 30.0% THEN irrigate=1 ELSE irrigate=0
rationale: Soil moisture below 30% of field capacity is a common trigger for irrigation in Indian Kharif and Rabi crops (source: ICAR guidelines). This baseline should be exceeded by any trained ML model.
python_implementation:
def rule_based_irrigate(soil_moisture_pct):
    return 1 if soil_moisture_pct < 30.0 else 0
